relationship: Follow-up designed after the six-dimensional texture scan; not retroactively part of its protocol
claim_under_test: The uniform-polarization fixed-envelope preparation is stationary under spatial polarization variations in both five and six dimensions
unchanged_physics: Leading spin-magnetic closed-field kernel plus positive bare polarization-gradient cost; no scalar-exchange or additional vector channel
envelope: Normalized unit-variance radial Gaussian in each ambient dimension
polarization_basis: Fundamental Spin(5) module and one fundamental Spin(6) half-spin module, both C^4
wave_direction: (e0+e4)/sqrt(2), retaining the first three visible axes in both models
variations: All six real ray-orthogonal spinor tangent directions
normalized_stationarity_residual: Gradient norm of E/(kappa*integral n^2); gradient kinetic contribution vanishes at the uniform reference
failure_meaning: A nonzero first variation rejects this uniform preparation, not the entire ambient dimension
scope: Conditional field model comparison; not a measured electron response or a spatial-orbit replacement
